title: Parasitology
modules: The Concept Of Epidemiology And Parasitic Disease
Measure Of Epidemiology And Disability Adjusted Life
The Concept And Scope Of Parasitology
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a polyphyletic group of unicellular animals whose mode of classification is primarily based on their locomotory organelle."
Protozoans are a polyphyletic group of unicellular animals whose mode of classification is primarily based on their locomotory organelle.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a quantitative science that evaluates the occurrence, distribution, determinants of control of disease pattern in a defined population."
Epidemiology is a quantitative science that evaluates the occurrence, distribution, determinants of control of disease pattern in a defined population.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the effect of biological compatibilities between hosts and parasites."
Specificity is the effect of biological compatibilities between hosts and parasites.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study of parasites, their hosts, and the relationship between them."
Parasitology is the study of parasites, their hosts, and the relationship between them.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called round worms because of their cylindrical appearance."
Nematodes are called round worms because of their cylindrical appearance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a controversial parasitic group because most feed on small invertebrates by way of predation."
Leeches are a controversial parasitic group because most feed on small invertebrates by way of predation.
fib: ______ is an irregular layer of circular muscle fibres, and within this again some rather scattered longitudinal fibres; there is no endothelium.
Inside the syncytium is an irregular layer of circular muscle fibres, and within this again some rather scattered longitudinal fibres; there is no endothelium.
______ refers to the unsuitability of a host.
Host resistance refers to the unsuitability of a host.
______ is a health indicator which translates disabilities into years of healthy life lost, by giving each disease state a disability weight ranging from zero (healthy) to 1 (death).
DALYs is a health indicator which translates disabilities into years of healthy life lost, by giving each disease state a disability weight ranging from zero (healthy) to 1 (death).
______ are a bizarre and poorly studied parasitic group which are important causes of very disturbing gastric and intestinal conditions.
Acanthocephalans are a bizarre and poorly studied parasitic group which are important causes of very disturbing gastric and intestinal conditions.
______ is the non-parasitic member in a parasitic association.
A host is the non-parasitic member in a parasitic association.
______ is an essential component of mutualistic relationships.
Physiological dependence is an essential component of mutualistic relationships.
